STANDARD FORM OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN CONTRACTOR AND SUBCONTRACTOR (AGC)

Project: Tier-1 Tower Core & Shell
Contractor: Skanska USA Building
Subcontractor: Bedrock Concrete Cutting

ARTICLE 1 — SCOPE OF WORK
Subcontractor shall furnish all labor, equipment and tools to perform wall sawing
and core drilling as described in the scope of work.

ARTICLE 8 — MEANS AND METHODS
8.2 Subcontractor shall furnish the labor, equipment, and tools necessary for the
proper performance of the Work and shall act as an independent contractor.

ARTICLE 9 — SCHEDULE
The schedule may change after signing. Subcontractor shall conform its sequence to
the current schedule. Overtime and premium time required to perform the work are
included.

ARTICLE 12 — PAYMENT
Payment within 30 days. Retainage 5%.

ARTICLE 17 — INDEMNIFICATION
Subcontractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Contractor including attorney's
fees, to the extent of Subcontractor's negligence.

ARTICLE 20 — INSURANCE
Additional insured, primary and non-contributory, waiver of subrogation. The
project is enrolled in an OCIP wrap-up program; enroll via the wrap portal before
mobilizing.
